title: Introducing Mastra FDE
summary: Forward-deployed engineers from the Mastra team, embedded with yours. If you're hiring an AI engineer, an option worth considering.
body_markdown:
Mastra has been helping companies ship agents for a long time. When our earliest adopters needed help getting agents into production, we sent our engineers to work in their codebase alongside them.


Some of the most demanding engineering teams in the world build on Mastra.[Salesforce](https://mastra.ai/customers/salesforce) built the harness behind Agentforce Vibes, the default engine for about 100K developers.[MongoDB](https://mastra.ai/customers/mongodb) built Sage, an internal agent platform that turns hours of CI log investigation into seconds.[Workday](https://mastra.ai/customers/workday) moved its security operations agents from Bedrock Agents to Mastra in 31 days, cutting 3,000 lines of code and about 98% of estimated vector storage costs.


Today we're turning this level of impact into an official offering you can have, too: **Mastra FDE** is our forward-deployed engineering program, open to any team building agents.


## Hiring AI engineers is time-consuming, slow, and expensive


If you're hiring an AI engineer now, you may have needed features for months. But the path to bringing someone on board typically takes months, requires having some blind trust in candidates, and is costly.


Mastra FDE helps you avoid all that. You get engineers who already know Mastra from the inside, working on your agents from the first week, for less than the cost of one senior AI hire. Use it to move faster while you hire, push hiring by a quarter or two, or not hire at all.


## What working with the framework builders is like


"The support that the team offered, the level of maturity at the time, and overall the ergonomics of the library were really nice." — Mohamed Khelif, Lead Engineer, MongoDB


"Mastra helped us build a solution quickly while keeping complete control of the underlying infrastructure and code." — Nick Gervasi, Senior Software Engineer, AngelList


The main part is a **dedicated Mastra FDE** embedded with your team, from architecture through production, with regular 1:1 check-ins. They can act more in a consultative capacity (6 hours / week), or actively build with you (20-40 hours / week).


But behind that FDE is the whole company:


- **A shared Slack channel** with Mastra's founders and engineers
- **Fast responses** from the Mastra team when something breaks, so you can keep building
- **Roadmap insights** , so you can plan around what's coming
- **Upskilling sessions** in the form of customized workshops, trainings, or Q&As
- **Mastra Enterprise** , including Knowledge, Trace Intelligence, and Agent Builder


The reason we're investing so heavily in this as an organization is that we've found these kinds of deep relationships are critical. Features like trace queries, thread view, and label-based factory routing have come out of conversations with our customers.


## Different patterns of engagement


Some teams want a short burst of help to get their first agent into production. Others want an ongoing partner as they scale. We'll scope it around what you're building and pick the structure of hours, deliverables, and engagement right for you.


## Get started


Tell us what you're building and where we can help.[Grab time with our team](https://calendly.com/mastra-team/mastra-fde) .
